blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — After a 12-year wait, a bettor from Batangas got a P14.3 million check from Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) on Wednesday (Nov. 25), which is also the eve of his 59th birthday. Antonio Mendoza got his P14,357,281.28 check more than three and a half years after the Supreme Court (SC) ordered PCSO to award him his P12,391,600 winnings as well as his attorney’s fees and moral damages. PCSO General Manager Mel Robles also gave Mendoza a birthday cake before handing him the check, according to a video posted on its Facebook page. “This is our first winner who […]...
